paper_title: Search for invisible axion dark matter with a multiple-cell haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (computed as 11.1 x g_KSVZ at the mass endpoints, using g_KSVZ = (alpha/pi)*0.97/f_a with m_a*f_a = 5.7e15 eV^2)
notes: CAPP-9T multiple-cell (double-cell) cavity haloscope. Paper reports an average exclusion of g_agamma >= 11.1 x g_KSVZ at 90% CL over 13.0-13.9 ueV (3.14-3.36 GHz). No numerical table is provided; the two data points are the KSVZ-model coupling at the mass range endpoints multiplied by 11.1. Actual limit curve (Fig. 5) has bin-by-bin variations and gaps near 13.35 ueV from mode mixing. Assumes rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 local axion DM density. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
